interval_years.quote: Licenses issued under this chapter shall be renewed biennially.

required.quote: Licenses shall be renewed every two years without examination and on payment of the required fees. However, by rule, the Board may establish a continuing education requirement.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to make available copies of instruments of service upon timely request when prepared for and paid for by the user
disciplinary_grounds.quote: failing to make available, upon the timely request of a person using engineering services, copies of instruments of service in the possession or under the control of the licensee, when those instruments of service have been prepared for and paid for by the user of services

disciplinary_grounds.description: Signing or sealing instruments of service for which the engineer is not in responsible charge, or negligently allowing use of the engineer's stamp

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making any material misrepresentation in the practice of engineering, by commission or omission

definition_quote.value: Professional engineering means any service or creative work, the adequate performance of which requires engineering education, training, and experience in the application of special knowledge of the mathematical, physical, and engineering sciences and the principles and methods of engineering analysis and design acquired by engineering education and engineering experience, insofar as the service or work involves safeguarding life, health, or property.
definition_quote.quote: "Professional engineering" means any service or creative work, the adequate performance of which requires engineering education, training, and experience in the application of special knowledge of the mathematical, physical, and engineering sciences and the principles and methods of engineering analysis and design acquired by engineering education and engineering experience, insofar as the service or work involves safeguarding life, health, or property.
